mission: Design the fastest safe external event loop that removes dependence on human dot turns for monitoring/compilation/projection while preserving Git/source authority and explicitly separating deterministic unattended metabolism from ChatGPT/model-required reasoning.

source_freshness.note: EPOCH advanced during concurrent /wc activity. Final prewrite reloaded EPOCH, compiled packet, convergence, own claim and own run; no blocking convergence event affecting this isolated claim/run/return scope was found.

useful_delta: Selected a minimal external metabolism architecture that reuses the existing GitHub Action runtime compiler and the already operational Supabase Cron/Edge substrate without making Supabase a new source of authority. The recommended v1 is an event-driven GitHub Actions metabolism tick with a 5-minute scheduled safety net, deterministic shadow projections, semantic no-op commits, explicit runtime dispatch, strict stale-policy gating, CAS/recompute on drift, and an optional Supabase read-only 1-minute heartbeat/projection accelerator. The return defines exact triggers, files, state machine, security boundaries, planner/stale/projection behavior, deployment sequence and falsification tests.
facts: The current throughput snapshot records 21 parent-seeded opportunities, 0 automatically generated opportunities and no unattended event loop; work generation/regeneration is the primary bottleneck.

The existing .github/workflows/agent-runtime-v3.yml already triggers on coordination/** changes, compiles/tests Agent Network v3 and publishes the derived runtime to gh-pages with repository contents write permission.

The existing Supabase project is ACTIVE_HEALTHY and already runs successful cron jobs, including one every minute; prometeo-change-loop-v1 is an active Edge Function, proving the project has an operational Edge/server-side substrate.
GitHub Actions scheduled workflows have a shortest documented interval of five minutes and can be delayed under load; therefore schedule is a backstop, not the only trigger.

Events caused by a workflow using the repository GITHUB_TOKEN normally do not recursively start workflows, while workflow_dispatch/repository_dispatch remain explicit exceptions. This supplies a useful anti-recursion boundary for self-committed derived projections.
Supabase Cron can invoke Edge Functions periodically; official documentation shows minute-level schedules and recommends keeping secrets in Vault for scheduled function calls.

route_choice.reason: All canonical queue/claim/run/return evidence already lives in Git and the existing Agent Runtime compiler/publisher already runs in GitHub Actions. Extending this substrate avoids a second authoritative database and avoids introducing a GitHub write credential into Supabase for the first deployable loop.

alternatives.reason: It can run every minute and the substrate is live, but mutating canonical Git state from Edge would require an additional scoped GitHub credential/App and a second failure/authorization plane. Use Supabase first as a low-latency read-only projection/heartbeat or explicit dispatcher, not canonical writer.
Five-minute minimum plus possible schedule delay is unnecessary latency when worker commits already provide immediate Git push events. Keep schedule only as recovery/backstop.
A chat turn cannot wake itself after the response ends; it can remain a reasoning/execution boundary but cannot be the scheduler.

candidate.authority_model: Git/source objects remain canonical. Metabolism outputs are deterministic derived/shadow projections and trigger receipts. They never confer Human Accepted, Current or Served authority.
candidate.drift_rule: Immediately before commit/push, compare the current main head and relevant source identities with H. If relevant inputs changed, discard candidate outputs and recompute from the new head. Bound retries; on repeated churn fail without writing stale derived state.

exact_files_to_build_first.role: Pure deterministic derivation helpers: load active queues, claims, runs, returns, proposals/incidents/critic inputs; lineage validation; semantic normalization; stale-policy checks; planner-trigger derivation; launch-demand derivation; privacy/public-safety checks.

One idempotent tick. Reads source truth at a single source head, derives shadow outputs from zero, writes only when semantic content changes, and exits nonzero on authority/privacy/freshness conflicts.
Deterministic lifecycle, drift, stale-policy, planner-trigger, dedup, privacy and anti-recursion falsification suite.
Fixtures for prepared/claimed/started/returned/done, missing return, explicit expired lease, lease-null old work, collision, critic/proposal inputs and mixed-head/privacy failures.
Push + schedule + workflow_dispatch runner with least privilege and single-writer concurrency.

shadow_outputs.purpose: Source head, trigger cause, semantic input/output digests, validation outcome and next deterministic boundary.
Derived working/done/waiting/problem counts, unconsumed returns, blockers and sanitized recent progress. Read-only projection.
Only candidates supported by an explicit lease/heartbeat/stale policy; missing policy produces a diagnostic, never implicit stale.
Evidence-linked reason that deterministic Planner work is due; this trigger is not itself generation N+1.
Derived number/categories of currently claimable compatible worker slots, dependencies and blockers; no fake percent complete.

candidate.shadow_location_note: Use the existing chat-native-control-plane workstream for the first Prometeo-root canary because shared/global ownership has not been separately promoted. A later steward may move the compiler/projection to a global capability owner after multi-root reconciliation.

github_triggers.schedule_role: Backstop for silence, stale-policy evaluation and lost/missed event recovery; not the primary low-latency trigger.

concurrency.reason: Keep one deterministic writer at a time. Idempotence handles duplicate triggers; do not cancel a tick after it has taken a source snapshot.

permissions: actions: write only if the implementation dispatches agent-runtime-v3.yml; otherwise omit

candidate.semantic_noop_rule: Exclude volatile compiled_at/trigger timestamps from the semantic digest used to decide whether to commit. If all derived semantic payloads are unchanged, exit successfully without a commit. This prevents schedule churn.

runtime_publication.rule: Do not duplicate the Agent Runtime compiler/publisher. After a metabolism self-commit, explicitly invoke the existing workflow_dispatch path (or later refactor to workflow_call) because pushes created with GITHUB_TOKEN normally do not recursively create another workflow run.
runtime_publication.failure_boundary: If derived runtime publication fails, canonical source truth remains unchanged. Mark projection freshness by source identity; next push/scheduled tick retries publication/derivation.

unattended_deterministic_allowed: scan durable source objects and validate lifecycle/schema/lineage
derive blockers/dependencies from explicit durable fields
detect explicit lease expiration when a governing lease/heartbeat/stale policy exists
emit one deduplicated stale candidate/incident from explicit evidence
derive planner-trigger inputs and generation-end conditions
deduplicate/replay-safe progress events by stable source transition identity
derive launch demand from READY + claims + dependencies + capability metadata
run tests/falsifiers and publish existing Agent Runtime projections
retry deterministic compilation after source-head drift
still_requires_model_or_chat_in_current_: strategic/creative Planner reasoning that invents new opportunities from ambiguous returns until an executable deterministic Planner/compiler is implemented
worker execution that depends on ChatGPT reasoning or connected tools
context-sensitive integration/steward decisions that alter architecture/method/authority
opening a fresh ChatGPT worker conversation under the present platform boundary
still_requires_human_authority: Human Accepted / Current / Served promotions where governing policy requires human acceptance
any credential or privacy boundary not already durably authorized
unattended_vs_model_boundary.critical_truth: The event loop can remove manual dot turns for observation, deterministic compilation and trigger creation. It cannot truthfully claim full autonomous compounding until Planner generation N+1 and worker invocation are executable through authorized compute rather than requiring a human/platform chat launch.

stale_retry_path.rule: Never infer stale from conversational silence or age alone.
stale_retry_path.lease_null_behavior: A claim/run with no explicit lease/heartbeat/stale policy remains non-stale regardless of elapsed wall time; emit STALE_POLICY_MISSING if this prevents recovery.
explicit_policy_behavior: evaluate lease/heartbeat policy against durable timestamps only
emit a stable stale-candidate identity referencing exact claim/run/attempt
do not overwrite the original attempt
only a separately authorized retry/supersession compiler creates the next attempt lineage
replay of the same expired attempt does not create duplicate stale events

trigger_inputs: READY claimable depth falls below a declared threshold
planner_path.trigger_output: PLANNER_TRIGGER.json contains generation id, exact evidence refs/digests, reason codes, dedup key, blockers and whether deterministic planner compute is available.
planner_path.no_fake_planning_rule: If there is no executable Planner compiler, emit PLANNER_COMPUTE_REQUIRED rather than synthesizing a queue inside the deterministic event loop.
planner_path.future_executable_path: Once O-PLANNER-RECURSIVE-LOOP-V1 is steward-integrated as an executable compiler, the tick may invoke it on the trigger artifact, validate generation N+1, and persist only isolated/generated queue artifacts permitted by that compiler's authority contract.

projection_path.continuity: Run the Continuity Head compiler in shadow mode, rebuilding from sources rather than incrementing old counters. Keep the manual head canonical until parity/fresh-parent promotion gates pass.
projection_path.live: Live consumes sanitized derived projection only. It may disappear or lag without affecting queue/claim/run correctness.
projection_path.progress: Use append-only/source-transition progress evidence and reconstruct time buckets at render/compile time; no periodic write is required merely to display two-hour buckets.

proven_live_capabilities: successful cron every minute in the connected project
safe_uses: one-minute read-only fetch of public Git/runtime projection for ambient Live freshness
future repository_dispatch invocation only after a narrowly scoped GitHub App/service credential and authority contract exist
do_not_do_in_v1: do not mirror canonical queue/claim/run state into mutable Supabase rows as a second authority
do not store a broad PAT in a public/anonymous Edge Function
do not expose SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY or GitHub credentials in public Git/projections
do not let Edge mutate Human Accepted/Current/Served authority
supabase_optional_accelerator.secret_rule: For cron-to-Edge calls, use server-side authenticated service-to-service patterns/Vault. Privileged secrets remain server-side and are never copied into public artifacts.

security_and_authority: Least privilege: metabolism Action gets only contents:write plus actions:write if explicit dispatch is used.
No private Supabase capture/transcript/token payload is copied into public Git-derived projections.
Every projection records exact source head/input digest so stale/mixed-head output is detectable.
Conflicting owner/Current/privacy identities fail closed; newest-wins is forbidden.

The metabolism workflow may write only derived/shadow artifacts and append-only incidents allowed by its promoted contract; it may not self-promote architecture, method, Current, Human Accepted or Served.
Self-commit messages should carry a stable automation prefix and a source digest; semantic no-op plus GitHub token recursion behavior prevents infinite commit loops.

A Supabase implementation requiring Git writes should prefer a narrowly scoped GitHub App/install token over a broad personal token and should be deferred until latency justifies the added trust surface.
minimal_deployment_sequence: D1 implement prometeo-metabolism-lib/tick plus fixture tests; no schedule and no canonical pointer changes.
D2 add prometeo-metabolism-v1 workflow with workflow_dispatch only; run historical wave1 replay and synthetic lifecycle fixtures in shadow mode.
D3 enable push triggers; prove one real worker return updates shadow Control Room/Planner Trigger without a human dot.
D4 enable */5 GitHub schedule backstop; prove repeated unchanged ticks produce zero commits.
D5 explicitly dispatch/reuse agent-runtime-v3 after a metabolism self-commit and prove public projection reaches the same source identity without recursive workflow storms.
D6 compare shadow Continuity projection against source-derived/manual verified state and perform fresh-parent transcript-erasure parity test.
D7 steward may promote the compiler/projection owner only after material divergences/privacy/authority findings are closed.
D8 optionally add Supabase one-minute read-only heartbeat/Live accelerator; keep Git canonical.

falsification_tests.test: Run two ticks against identical source head H.
falsification_tests.pass: Semantic outputs are identical and second tick creates no commit.

falsification_tests.test: Persist a real worker RETURN/DONE under allowed fixture/canary path.
falsification_tests.pass: Push-triggered metabolism reflects the return/unconsumed state and planner trigger without a human dot turn.

falsification_tests.test: Advance a relevant source path after the tick snapshots H but before write.
falsification_tests.pass: Candidate output from H is discarded; tick reloads/recomputes or exits without stale write.

falsification_tests.test: Use an old CLAIMED/STARTED attempt whose lease/heartbeat policy is null.
falsification_tests.pass: No STALE or retry is inferred; diagnostic says policy missing.

falsification_tests.test: Use an attempt with a governing explicit expired lease and valid lineage.
falsification_tests.pass: Exactly one deduplicated stale candidate is emitted; original attempt is preserved.

falsification_tests.test: RETURN exists but terminal DONE does not.
falsification_tests.pass: Projection reports RETURNED_NOT_TERMINAL or governing equivalent, never DONE.

falsification_tests.test: DONE claims success without required durable return evidence.
falsification_tests.pass: Validation fails/incident is surfaced; success is not counted.
Stable trigger identity prevents duplicate generation request.

falsification_tests.test: Rebuild from the seven-claim/seven-run/seven-return wave1 source snapshot.
falsification_tests.pass: Derived counts match durable evidence and no old snapshot counter is trusted.

falsification_tests.test: Fixture includes a private source/token/capture payload.
falsification_tests.pass: Public projections contain only authorized sanitized metadata; payload/token leakage fails the job.

falsification_tests.test: Metabolism commits a changed shadow projection with GITHUB_TOKEN.
falsification_tests.pass: No uncontrolled recursive push loop occurs; at most one explicit runtime dispatch occurs per metabolism source/output digest.

falsification_tests.test: Force runtime dispatch/publish to fail after a valid metabolism commit.
falsification_tests.pass: Source truth stays valid; public projection exposes its older source identity and next tick can retry.

falsification_tests.test: Skip/delay one scheduled tick then run the next tick.
falsification_tests.pass: Full source re-derivation recovers all transitions; correctness does not depend on observing every timer event.
Queue/claim/run/return correctness and metabolism derivation are unaffected.

acceptance_checkpoint_completion.proof: unattended_vs_model_boundary explicitly partitions deterministic, model-required and human-authority work
route A selected with exact workflow/script/test files, push triggers, */5 schedule backstop and state machine
Git remains canonical; shadow outputs only; least privilege, privacy fail-closed, CAS/recompute and optional Supabase boundaries defined

acceptance_checkpoint_completion.checkpoint: stale/planner/projection trigger path and falsifiers defined
acceptance_checkpoint_completion.proof: stale_retry_path, planner_path, projection_path and F1-F14 falsification suite

unresolved_boundaries: O-PLANNER-RECURSIVE-LOOP-V1 must return and be steward-reconciled before the event loop can truthfully create generation N+1 autonomously.
Generic stale/retry/supersession remains unproven; the event loop must not invent a timeout policy.
ChatGPT worker invocation remains an external platform/human boundary in the current product surface; this design does not claim to spawn hidden background chats.
Shared/global ownership for the eventual multi-root metabolism compiler is not promoted; v1 shadow path remains under chat-native-control-plane until steward reconciliation.
Supabase write-to-Git credentials are intentionally not introduced in v1.

candidate_next_work_proposals.mission: Implement scripts/prometeo-metabolism-lib.mjs, scripts/prometeo-metabolism-tick.mjs, fixture suite and workflow_dispatch-only shadow Action using this return as acceptance contract.
After shadow tests pass, enable push triggers and */5 schedule; prove real return propagation, no-op stability, drift CAS and explicit runtime dispatch without recursive workflow storms.
Optionally use existing Supabase Cron/Edge infrastructure for a one-minute read-only ambient heartbeat/public projection refresh without Git mutation credentials.

negative_knowledge: Do not treat a timer as autonomy; compounding requires Planner generation N+1 plus executable compute/worker invocation.
Do not infer stale from silence/age when lease policy is absent.
Do not build a second mutable authority plane in Supabase merely because cron is faster.
Do not duplicate the existing Agent Runtime compiler/publisher.
Do not let self-committed volatile timestamps generate an endless commit stream.
Do not claim Live/Control Room freshness as source truth.
